services.title: Organizational services
services.intro: A service is a controlled connection to an org system (ops DB, accounting, …). Credentials stay server-side; granted users' assistants reach it only through the gateway, capped at their access level.
services.name: Service name
services.descriptionHint: Helps the assistant understand what data this service holds; be precise.
services.connReadHint: A DB account with SELECT-only grants. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
services.connRotateHint: Enter a new value to rotate; leave empty to keep.
services.connWriteHint: Unused until the change-approval flow ships.
services.noGrants: No users granted yet — without a grant, users cannot see this service at all.
services.deleteConfirmBody: Delete “{{name}}” with all its grants and call history? This cannot be undone.
services.builderHint: Faster path: tell your assistant "build a new service" in chat — the service-builder connects, writes the skill, and grants access.
services.knowledgeIntro: Rules here apply to every granted user whenever the assistant uses this service (appended to the service skill). Knowledge = definitions, table meanings, domain notes.
services.knowledgeForUserHint: Applies only to that user and only when using this service.

knowledge.title: My knowledge
knowledge.intro: Everything here is available to the assistant in all your chats: a rule is always followed; knowledge is used when relevant. In chat you can also say “remember …”.
knowledge.learningHint: The system extracts durable facts (role, preferences, corrections) from your chats and stores them here tagged “learned”; you can delete any of them.
knowledge.noTeams: You are not a member of any team.
knowledge.serviceNotesHint: Your personal notes and rules for this service — applied only when using it.
knowledge.teamHint: Shared team knowledge and rules — applies to every member; any member can edit.

editor.kindRuleHint: A binding instruction, always followed (e.g. “write amounts in rials”).
editor.contentHint: Keep it short and self-contained; every entry travels with the assistant each turn and costs tokens.

admin.title: Organizational knowledge & learning
admin.learningHint: Every {{interval}} min, conversations idle for {{idle}} min with at least {{min}} new user messages are digested by the cheapest model; durable facts are added to the user's knowledge (tagged learned). Cap per user: {{max}}. Users can opt out.
admin.datasetTitle: Dataset for training an org model
admin.datasetHint: JSONL export (one conversation per line, user/assistant messages) for analysis or later fine-tuning. Every export is audit-logged — these are people's chats.
admin.userHint: Rules/knowledge about this person — applied in all their chats. Admin entries are read-only for the user; “learned” ones were extracted from their chats.
admin.teamHint: Shared team rules/knowledge — for every member.
admin.serviceHint: Service rules/knowledge — for every granted user, when using the service.
